about: Screensaver readiness survey of every shown page, 2026-10-01. One record per page: tier (1 generic .. 5 unsuitable), render path, main canvas, GUI selectors, a hook plan with file:line refs, calm risks, recording notes, estimated hook lines. Read by the people and agents that write window.snSaver hooks. The tier and note in stella-nova/lib/screensaver-catalog.js come from here.

pages.label: Wiki
pages.render: dom
pages.plan: Exclude. stella-nova/pages/wiki/main.js is a hash router that draws text articles from window.SN_DATA into #view; storage.js calls fetch(). index.html has no <canvas>, only icon SVGs. Nothing moves and captureStream has nothing to record.
pages.calmRisks: network (storage.js fetch); no visual output
pages.recordNotes: No canvas. The generic fallback would find no canvas and hide everything.

pages.label: Research
pages.render: svg
pages.plan: Exclude. research/main.js draws a tech-tree board of DOM node cards and SVG paths (main.js:213 createElementNS path). Its only requestAnimationFrame (main.js:257) is a one-shot scroll or zoom ease. window.__research exists but the page is a static diagram. A slow pan across the tree could be done later, but captureStream cannot record DOM or SVG. If the user wants it, a tier 4 rewrite would draw the board to a canvas.

pages.recordNotes: No canvas. DOM and SVG content cannot be recorded.

pages.label: Station Guide
pages.render: canvas2d
pages.plan: Long-form tutorial with six small 2D canvases, one per figure (index.html:62,81,100,120,140,164). Each figure is a Board (guide/board.js:80) sized from canvas.parentNode.clientWidth in Board.prototype.resize (board.js:90). That sets canvas.style width and height in px, so the generic pin stretches a small backing buffer. One loop (board.js:278) steps only figures with f.on === true, and an IntersectionObserver sets f.on (board.js:274). Hook: add window.snSaver in guide/main.js. In enter(), pin one figure's .cvbox full-frame and set the Board cell size from min(innerWidth/cols, innerHeight/rows), then call resize. Force that figure's f.on = true, because the observer may say it is off-screen. Then cycle figures every opts.seconds/3: hero (heroFigure chapters.js:51, a slow scan line at t*0.12), foundry (foundryFigure chapters.js:202, items move ore to ingot), and crew (crewFigure chapters.js:294, crew walk to job spots). For calm, scale dt in loop() by (1 - 0.6*calm). Hide header, nav#chaps, text sections, .fig-status and .fig-pal. GD.figure (board.js:271) holds the figs array in a closure. Expose the figs array, or the Board per figure, on window.GD so that the hook can reach them. Placement, enclosure and decompress figures wait for clicks, so leave them out of the cycle.
pages.calmRisks: none; the scan line is gentle. Figure swaps are cuts, so add a CSS opacity fade.
pages.recordNotes: Six canvases. The hook must move the one recorded canvas between figures, or draw the active board into one stable canvas. The status lines and ore chips are DOM and are not recorded.

pages.label: Station Planner
pages.render: canvas2d
pages.plan: Editor, but it ships a built-in layout: PL.example() (planner/model.js:318), which boot() loads when there is no share hash and no localStorage key 'sn-planner-v1' (main.js:469-481). view.js draws only on demand: ask() (view.js:104) runs one rAF draw, so the page is static when idle. Hook in planner/main.js: enter() hides the selectors, then runs a timed build-up. Keep L = PL.example(), call PL.load([]) to get only the core, then on a timer add one module per step with PL.add(t,x,y,r) and PL.commit(), then changed() and VW.ask(). Use a step of about 0.6-1.2 s scaled by calm. Ease VW.cam (view.js:35, exposed on window.VW, view.js:340) with a slow drift and zoom toward VW.fit() targets, and call VW.ask() every frame from the hook's own rAF. When the build is done, hold, then fade out and rebuild. Do not write localStorage in saver mode: changed() may save the session, so guard it with a saver flag. Set UI.tool = 'select', UI.ghost = null and UI.sel = 0 so that no hover ghost or selection shows.
pages.calmRisks: none; one module appears at a time. Add a short alpha ease per module so that no module pops in.
pages.recordNotes: Single canvas. The canvas has no animation without the hook's own rAF, so the recording is frozen without the autopilot.

pages.label: Ship Designer
pages.render: canvas2d
pages.plan: The fleet canvas (#fleetCanvas, index.html) already flies on its own. fleetStep (ship-designer/main.js:610) runs wander and formation modes, and fleetFrame (main.js:704) runs while fleet.onScreen, fleet.visible and !fleet.paused are true. Do not use the generic fallback. It may pick #shipCanvas (512x512 static) as the largest canvas. fleetResize (main.js:574) also sizes the canvas from #fleetWrap, not from the canvas, so a pinned canvas stretches. Hook inside the IIFE in main.js, because fleet and state are closure vars. enter(): pin #fleetWrap (not the canvas) position:fixed inset:0 so that the ResizeObserver runs fleetResize. Hide the selectors. Set fleet.speed = 1 - 0.6*calm (about 0.4-0.6), fleet.count = 18-24, then fleetSeed(), fleet.mode = 'formation' or alternate per seed, fleet.paused = false, fleet.onScreen = true, then fleetKick(). Once per dwell, pick a livery with applyPreset(PRESETS[seed % PRESETS.length]) (main.js:241, PRESETS main.js:70). Return { canvas: fleet.canvas }.
pages.calmRisks: engine flame length flickers at sin(t*40) (main.js:681), about 6 Hz, with 0.8-1.0 amplitude. It is small but fast, so in calm mode scale the 40 down or set fleet.glow=false. A livery change re-tints all ships at once (a hard cut).
pages.recordNotes: Only #fleetCanvas is recorded. The hero ship preview and the livery name are separate DOM and canvas elements.

pages.label: Flag Designer
pages.render: canvas2d
pages.plan: #flagCanvas inside #heroWrap (index.html:63) shows a waving cloth. clothFrame (flag-designer/main.js:847) advances cloth.t += dt while view is 'wave', it is not paused and it is on screen. clothResize (main.js:757) sizes the canvas from #heroWrap's rect, so the generic pin of the canvas alone stretches it. Hook in the main.js IIFE: pin #heroWrap fixed inset:0 so that the ResizeObserver resizes the canvas. Hide the selectors. Set cloth.view='wave', cloth.paused=false, cloth.onScreen=true and cloth.wind = 0.25 + 0.3*(1-calm), then clothKick(). Add a time scale: change main.js:851 to cloth.t += dt * (cloth.tScale||1) and set tScale = 1 - 0.5*calm. Pick a preset per dwell: copy PRESETS[seed % 14] (main.js:286, fields [name,c1,c2,c3,ce,pattern,shape,emblem]) into state (main.js:315), then schedulePaint(). paint() calls writeHash() (main.js:419), which is harmless in the iframe but can be skipped in saver mode.
pages.calmRisks: none at low wind. A preset change swaps the texture at once (a cut).
pages.recordNotes: Single canvas, which records cleanly. The flag name and subtitle are DOM.

pages.label: Selection
pages.render: canvas2d
pages.plan: #cv fills main#stage. resize() (selection/main.js:676) reads #stage's rect every frame, and frame() (main.js:820) runs always, so drifters and orbiters move idle (step main.js:803). The lesson area Y0/Y1 (main.js:348-351) comes from the hint and dock DOM positions, so recompute it after hiding: call loadLesson(S.lesson) after the hide. The generic fallback shows drifting sprites. The page only teaches when selections happen, so add an autopilot through window.__snSelection = {S, ents, loadLesson, toScreen, zoomAt} (main.js:928). Every opts.seconds/6: loadLesson((i+1)%6). Then fake a box gesture: set S.g = {mode:'box', sx, sy, cx, cy} and ease cx,cy over 1.5 s. Set S.preview to the ents inside, then set e.sel=true on the winning type (the box ladder: planet < ship < enemy...). Hold 2 s, then clear. Alternate with click picks: set e.sel on one ent under a point. Ease S.cam.z slowly with zoomAt for the station split lesson. Do not write localStorage 'sn_selection_lesson' in saver mode.
pages.calmRisks: lesson switch respawns all entities (a cut), so fade it. The reticles are thin and do not flash.
pages.recordNotes: Single canvas. The box labels draw on the canvas. The readout, lesson text and ladders are DOM and are not recorded.

pages.plan: Exclude. pages/for-tom/index.html is a long scrolling design doc (ASTROTECHS OPS: .topnav, .bootbar, hero, numbered <section class="section"> blocks, register table). main.js:1-33 wires hover flow diagrams, a hold-to-fire recoil SVG sim, a dilation slider sim, a filterable table. pages.label: Starward Belt
pages.render: mixed: webgpu dust field on canvas#field (engine.js) + SVG chart (svg#overlay, overlay.js) holding all stations, labels and routes
pages.plan: Generic fallback is wrong here: it would pin canvas#field (dust only) and hide svg#overlay, which holds every station and route. Hook goes in starward-belt/main.js next to window.__sb (main.js:740). enter(opts): (1) hide guiSelectors; keep #title and #plate only when opts.caption. (2) Turn on the drift without persisting: set state.animate=true then sync() (main.js:342) instead of setAnimate(), because setAnimate (main.js:187) writes localStorage 'starward-belt:animate' and the hash. (3) Autopilot timer, period ~max(8s, opts.seconds/3): pick two random ids from map.NODES (seeded by opts.seed), set state.selected=[a,b] and call plot(true) (main.js:272) -> cheapest() route + frameCourse() camera glide (camera.focus eases via camera.step); hold, then clearSelection() (main.js:265) + goHome() (main.js:316) for a wide view. (4) Optionally once per dwell call swapTo(randomSeed()) (main.js:122, 180 ms veil fade via body.swapping) for a new procedural belt; call swapTo directly, not randomize(), to keep the hash/history clean. calm=1: longer holds (15-20s), no map swaps. exit(): clear timers, clearSelection(), restore state.animate from before, goHome(). Return {canvas: null-equivalent? no: return {canvas: field canvas, warmupMs: 600}} but note recording limitation. All page state is module-scoped, so the hook must live inside main.js.
pages.calmRisks: WebGPU required for the dust field (SVG still works without). Map swap is a short 180 ms fade, not a hard cut. No audio, no network in loop (only shaders/field.wgsl fetch at boot, engine.js:62).
pages.recordNotes: Recording #field captures only the dust field; stations, labels and course lines are SVG in svg#overlay and would be missing. A useful MP4 needs the shell to composite the SVG (serialize overlay to an Image each frame) or the page to draw nodes into a 2D canvas for recording.

pages.label: Solar Transit Study
pages.render: canvas2d (7 small canvases: sparklines #cvHi/#cvLo/#cvSun/#cvRn, compass #nC, map #mapC, sky dome #skyC) + DOM dashboard
pages.plan: Exclude by default. It is a light-theme three-column analysis dashboard for one stadium site; the hero #hImg shows only user-loaded render stills (index.html:75, placeholder 'Load images & scrub timeline'), so the main panel is empty without user files. Nothing animates idle. If a tier-3 variant is ever wanted: show only #skyC (drawSky, main.js:122) and #mapC (drawMap, main.js:115) full-frame, start playback by setting pl=true and the setInterval from the #tPl handler (main.js:145, steps tSl value by pSp*2 minutes every 25 ms; use pSp=1 for calm), and every loop change sD to a new date (21st of each month) then call updateSolEv()/upd(). Globals are top-level let in a classic script (main.js:68-70), reachable from a hook appended to main.js. Both canvases size from parentElement (sC, main.js:83), so a pinned canvas needs its parent resized too.
pages.calmRisks: none (static); the generic fallback would pin #mapC (largest) which does not move
pages.recordNotes: Generic fallback picks #mapC, a static chart; the sky dome is a separate canvas, readouts are DOM.

pages.label: PBR Material Studio
pages.render: webgpu (viewport canvas#vp) + DOM node graph editor, library, inspector, maps strip
pages.plan: Editor, but it boots into a material: presets.js:565-576 loads DEFAULT_PRESET 'rustedIron' and there are 16 recipe presets (MATERIAL_PRESETS, presets.js:438-461) plus 12 procedural env presets (env.js:70-83 PRESETS: studio, goldenHour, blueHour, forest, neon...). So content exists; it needs an autopilot, not authored content. Hook in main.js after boot (window.__studio, main.js debug hook section). enter(opts): (1) hide guiSelectors; make #viewport-wrap position:fixed;inset:0 so viewport.js resize() (viewport.js:170) refits. (2) store.setView({autoRotate:true, mesh:'shaderBall'}) (store.js:101; MESHES contract.js:371); turntable speed is cam.autoSpeed 0.35 rad/s (camera.js:116), lower it to ~0.12-0.2 for calm (cam is bound in the viewport shared state, viewport.js:80/124; expose it on __studio.viewport). (3) Autopilot every ~opts.seconds/2: loadPreset(pr) from panels/material-view.js:95 (dynamic import of the same module URL returns the live instance) cycling MATERIAL_PRESETS by seed, and store.setEnv({preset:id}) cycling ONLY procedural PRESETS ids from env.js:70; never 'ph:*' ids (PH_PRESETS fetch Poly Haven HDRIs over the network, env.js:85-96, env.js:488). Optionally cycle mesh among sphere/shaderBall/torus/roundedCube. Return {canvas: #vp, warmupMs: ~2000} for the first bake (bake.js listens to graph:changed, bake.js:782). exit(): restore view/env, reload the user graph snapshot taken at enter (state.graph via graph serialize), because loadPreset replaces the user's working graph and pushes undo history; viewport savePrefsSoon (viewport.js:187) persists view prefs to localStorage, so restore those too.
pages.calmRisks: Each preset swap triggers a GPU bake (brief hitch, material pops from old to new without crossfade); a swap every 20-30 s with calm=1 is fine. Network only if a Poly Haven env is picked (avoid). Side effects on user state: replaces the working graph, writes view prefs to localStorage.
pages.recordNotes: captureStream of #vp gets the lit turntable; DOM toasts/HUD are not captured (hidden anyway). WebGPU canvas captureStream works in Chrome; check Safari.

pages.label: Hohmann Transfer
pages.render: canvas2d (canvas#cvs) + DOM topbar, preset cards, action bar, KaTeX eq panel and math drawer
pages.plan: Idle it only shows planets orbiting with no transfer; the interesting part (transfer ellipse, launch windows, ship coast, burn vectors) needs two clicks and a Launch. Also resize() (data.js:102) sizes the canvas from #canvasArea and writes inline style width/height, so the generic fallback's CSS pin gets overridden; make #canvasArea fill the frame (position:fixed;inset:0) then call resize(). Hook: append to input.js or main.js (classic scripts; planets/source/target/xfer/ship/simTime/launchScore are top-level let in data.js:83-90, so a classic-script hook can read and write them). Autopilot state machine per cycle: (1) pick source,target from planets (seeded, r different); set source=..., target=..., xfer=computeXfer(source.r,target.r) (data.js:267), launchWindows=computeWindows(source,target,xfer,simTime) (data.js:290), setEqPanelActive(true); renderMath(). (2) wait until nearestWindowDt(source,target,xfer,simTime) (data.js:323) is near 0, then launch() (input.js:109). (3) when ship.arrived (render.js updateShip ~566) hold 3-5 s, then clearSel() (input.js:152). (4) every 3-4 transfers or once per dwell, loadPreset(name) (data.js:212) cycling random/inner/outer/laplace/binary. Speed: set #spSlider value (read each frame, render.js ~frame line 74 of updateShip block) to 0.08-0.15 for calm (default 0.25). Suppress the grade card by setting launchScore=null right after launch() (drawScoreOverlay render.js:423) or keep it when opts.caption. setTbar banner is DOM, hidden.
pages.calmRisks: none heavy; grade card pops in/out on canvas (fade 2 s); radar sweep spoke is faint. No network, no audio.
pages.recordNotes: Planet names, orbits, ship, ellipse, burn marks are drawn on #cvs and record fine. The status bar, transfer banner (#tbar) and KaTeX equations are DOM and are not captured.

pages.label: LEO Catalog
pages.render: webgl (three.js, canvas#scene) + many DOM overlays (city/sat/station labels, chip, reticle, panels)
pages.plan: Idle it shows the globe with satellites moving at SIM.speed=3 (main.js:128-134), which is near-static, and the camera does not move. window.__leoXR (main.js:2435) already exposes {SIM, controls, camera, renderer, sats, satPoints} after startXR() at the end of boot() (main.js:2371-2400), so the hook can be written as a small snSaver in main.js that waits for boot. enter(opts): (1) wait for boot to finish (splash + catalog; return warmupMs ~6000-8000, or resolve when __leoXR appears). (2) hide guiSelectors; turn off the DOM label overlays via the xr setOverlay(k,false,true) path (main.js startXR ~2410: OVERLAY.cities / OVERLAY.satlabels) so labels do not hang over a recorded canvas. (3) controls.autoRotate=true, controls.autoRotateSpeed=0.25-0.4 (OrbitControls, created main.js:298; controls.update() already runs each frame main.js:2464). (4) SIM.speed via applyRate(rateSpeedToFrac(x)) (main.js:2124) to ~60x (calm=1) .. 300x so orbits visibly sweep and the terminator moves; keep SIM.playing=true. (5) optional tour every ~opts.seconds/3: flyToSat(idx) (main.js:1911, 1400 ms cubic ease) to a station (ISS etc., category station) then flyTo back to camera distance ~3.4 (main.js:1936); but flyToSat also calls lockChipTo (shows #chip), keep #chip hidden. exit(): restore SIM.speed 3, autoRotate false. Generic fallback alone would show the canvas pinned but static camera; canvas already sizes from window.innerWidth (main.js:2165), so pinning works.
pages.calmRisks: Boot does network: world-atlas coastlines from cdn.jsdelivr.net (main.js:322), TLE snapshot same-origin (never hit CelesTrak per memory), NOAA storms through CORS proxies (main.js:696-712), loadWeather. All at boot, not in the loop; storms may fail offline (harmless). Splash intro takes several seconds. High SIM.speed makes satellites streak; keep <= 300x.
pages.recordNotes: Canvas records globe, satellites, trails, streamlines. City/station/sat labels, chip and reticle are DOM and are lost; hide them so on-screen and recorded match. Check renderer preserveDrawingBuffer not needed for captureStream (it is fine in Chrome).

pages.label: Gravity Sim
pages.render: canvas2d (#simCanvas main, plus #energyGraph and #resonanceCanvas in side panels) + DOM panels
pages.plan: It moves on its own (laplace preset, loop() main.js:752), but the generic fallback breaks sizing: resizeCanvas() (main.js:297) sets canvas.width and inline style.width/height from #canvasArea, so a CSS pin gives a stretched canvas. Hook (append to main.js; all state is top-level var, main.js:60-81): enter(opts): hide guiSelectors; set #canvasArea to position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:top; call resizeCanvas(); centerCamera(). Declutter: showForce=false, showVel=false, showAcc=false, showGrid=false (or keep faint), showField=false, showLines=false, showTrails=true, trailLen=900 (main.js:62-63). Calm: timeScale=0.6-0.8 (setTimeScale(v) main.js:661 takes v=timeScale*10). Cycle presets each dwell slice with loadPreset(name) (main.js:164): laplace, figure8, solar, binary; skip 'chaos' (chaos5, ejections and close passes) or allow it only at calm<0.5. Watchdog: if any body leaves ~3x view radius, reload the current preset. exit(): restore flags and resizeCanvas().
pages.calmRisks: Close encounters can whip bodies fast; chaos preset ejects bodies. Loading a preset is a hard cut (trails cleared); acceptable at dwell boundaries. No network, no audio.
pages.recordNotes: All bodies and trails are on #simCanvas. Readouts, energy graph and resonance dial are separate canvases/DOM and are not recorded (hidden).

pages.label: Planet Forge
pages.render: webgl (three.js renderer canvas created inside #three-mount, main.js:380) + DOM topbar/sidebar/batch panel
pages.plan: Starts with only a holo wireframe placeholder and '#empty-state: select parameters and generate' (index.html:137); a planet appears only after the user presses Generate. The content is procedural, so an autopilot that drives Generate is enough (no authored content). State lives inside the async IIFE (main.js:52), so the hook goes inside main.js before the closing '})();'. enter(opts): hide guiSelectors; make #viewport / #three-mount fixed full-frame and call resize() (main.js:509, reads mount.clientWidth). Autopilot each ~opts.seconds/2 (min 20 s): set #sel-type to a seeded choice of selena/desert/terra/water/ice/ice_giant/gas_giant, #sel-temp 0..4, #inp-seed random, #sel-res 512 or 1024 (CPU generate() main.js:352 runs per texel; 2048+ stalls), then click #btn-gen (handler main.js:629). The live paint (scan ring sweeping pole to pole) is itself a calm reveal. Spin: anim() rotates dr.ry+=.0008/frame when not dragging (main.js:515), keep or reduce; window.__forge={ren,scn,cam,dr} (main.js:519) exposes dr for rotation and cam. Sun angle could drift slowly via sunPhi + updSun() (main.js:444). Return {warmupMs: time of the first generate, ~3-6 s}. Disable the end-of-gen shockwave pulse() (main.js:474) for calm, or set RM=true which makes tween() instant.
pages.calmRisks: CPU generation at 1024 blocks a few frames per band (yields every 4 rows via rAF, so mostly smooth). pulse() shockwave ring flashes on completion. Topbar clock setInterval is harmless. No network in loop (shader fetch at boot only).
pages.recordNotes: The three.js canvas has no id; select it as '#three-mount canvas'. Planet info readouts (#i-type, #i-seed) are DOM, not captured.

pages.label: Galaxy
pages.render: webgl (raw WebGL2, canvas#c)
pages.plan: Generic fallback is enough: one full-window canvas#c (index.html:33), resize() sizes from window.innerWidth/innerHeight (main.js resize, ~line 181) so the pin + resize event works, and the frame loop (main.js frame) turns the galaxy every frame from u_time*u_timescale with timescale 0.5 default. Arms and TIME_OFFSET are random per load, so each visit differs. Everything else (.hud title, .stats fps, .hint, .slider-wrap) is decorative DOM. Optional tier-2 polish later (needs a hook inside the IIFE, main.js:52): slow camera drift on dragX/dragY and a gentle tilt sweep; do not change timescale live because time*timescale makes the phase jump.
pages.calmRisks: none; additive point sprites, steady motion. Shader fetch at boot only.
pages.recordNotes: Everything is on #c; nothing lost.

pages.label: Black Hole
pages.render: webgl (raw WebGL2 full-screen ray-marched fragment shader, canvas#c, render-scaled)
pages.plan: Generic fallback is enough: frame() starts unconditionally (main.js:282) even before the GPU warning is dismissed (warnDismissed only gates the UI reveal, main.js:146-153), autoSpin=true rotates camYaw by SPIN_SPEED 0.0008/frame (main.js:106-107, 247), and RenderScale.resize reads window.innerWidth (lib/render-scale.js:59), CSS-upscaling the reduced canvas, so the pinned canvas stays correct. #gpuWarn and control bars are DOM and get hidden. Optional tier-2 later: window.setQuality(0) (main.js:137) for lower GPU load and a slow camPitch sine drift inside the IIFE; setBg(3) nebula as an alternate.
pages.calmRisks: Heavy GPU (per-pixel geodesic march; render-scale drops resolution when fps is low). No flashing, no network in loop, no audio.
pages.recordNotes: All on #c. Canvas renders at ~0.4 of window resolution, so the MP4 is low-res unless recording scales; fps/mode text is DOM.

pages.label: Wormhole
pages.render: webgl (raw WebGL2 full-screen ray tracer, canvas#c) + 2D minimap canvas#minimap (hidden by default)
pages.plan: Generic fallback already gives a slow orbit (autoSpin, SPIN_SPEED 0.0008, main.js:84-85) and RenderScale sizes from the window, so tier 1 would show. The better picture is the auto fly-through: window.toggleDescend() (main.js toggleDescend, ~line 128) moves camL toward and through the throat into Universe B and back, easing near the throat (updateDescent, speedMult 0.15..1, bounces at |camL|=18). A tiny hook (can live inside the IIFE or simply call the window.* functions): enter(opts): hide guiSelectors; call window.toggleDescend(); toggleDescend calls pauseSpin, which re-arms autoSpin after SPIN_RESUME_MS 4 s, so orbit plus descent combine. Calm: scale baseSpeed 4.0 (updateDescent) down to ~2.0 at calm=1 (needs the hook inside main.js since baseSpeed is a local const), optionally setBg(3) nebula per cycle. exit(): call toggleDescend() again if descending. The #minimap stays display:none until dismissWarn, and the hook must not call dismissWarn (it reveals the control bars).
pages.calmRisks: Heavy GPU ray march. Passing the throat swaps the visible sky to Universe B quickly near camL=0 (the descent slows there, so it reads as a transition, not a cut). No network, no audio.
pages.recordNotes: Main view all on #c. The minimap is a separate canvas and the HUD universe label is DOM; neither is recorded.

pages.label: Atomic Orbital
pages.render: webgl (three.js, OrbitControls)

pages.plan: Uses the SHARED TABLE HOOK (see beam page plan). Page specifics: stella-nova/pages/heat-diffraction/page.js samples a shared photo texture; main.js fetches ../postfx-table/photos.json once at boot (not in the loop). PAGE.select(id, btn) (page.js select) swaps the photo via PAGE.tick pending copy; the hook should call PAGE.select(nextPhotoId, matching #thumbs button) every 3-4 cells for variety (photo ids = Object.keys(ctx.photos)). Generators: energy map y=>1.6y (bias 0.55), tempo y=>0.1+2.9y, zoom y=>0.7+1.1y. Calm: tempo bias 0.05-0.31, energy bias 0.4 (gentler distortion). Curated list: rising_haze, fine_haze, ground_haze, layered_haze, mirage_floor, mirage_road, mirage_pool, mirage_soft, schlieren_plume, hot_column, twin_columns, candle_heat, chimney_heat, plume_lean, hot_core, spectral_haze, thermal_fringe, curl_air, vortex_air, eddies, caustic_light, heat_glow. pages.label: Heat Metal
pages.render: webgpu compute (61 per-tile 128x128 rgba32float ping-pong heat sims, present pass to tile canvases + #m-orb, shared table-engine)
pages.plan: Uses the SHARED TABLE HOOK (see beam page plan). Page specifics (stella-nova/pages/heat-metal/page.js): sims step only while the tile moves (draw at page.js:43-48, guarded by pg.lastFrame === ctx.sigTime(), so drawing the inspected tile into msurf and its tile surface in one frame does not double-step). leave(t) (page.js:31) schedules a reset; tick (page.js:32) applies it when t.rate eases to 0. On each cell switch the hook should call PAGE.leave(prev) and set next.page.reset = true; next.page.seed = seeded random, so each cell starts from a cold plate. Only one generator: tempo map y=>0.2+2.8y; calm bias 0.0 (0.2x) at calm=1 to 0.29 (1x) at calm=0. Sim is 128x128 upscaled to full frame: soft/blurry but acceptable for heat. Curated list (point sources with falloff, per user memory): orbit_slow, orbit, lissajous, drift, figure8, spiral, comet, twin, triple, ring_source, soak, core_bloom, breathe, cool_wave, plume_rise, convection, advect_swirl, vortex, curl_drift, ignite_wander. Exclude jitter, flicker_die, hard_quench, blast, billet_pulse, pulse_grid, white_hot, storm, flare, chain, wildfire, rain, scatter (flashy or full-field). Dwell longer (>=15 s) so the field builds up.
pages.calmRisks: blast/flicker/quench/pulse cells flash; full-field noise cells conflict with the user's point-source rule (heat-metal was rejected for this look); cold-plate start is black for a second after each switch
pages.recordNotes: Record #m-orb only; labels and the reset button are DOM.

pages.label: Fractal Orb
pages.render: webgl (three.js r-series, EffectComposer with chromatic aberration pass)
pages.plan: Single canvas = renderer.domElement inserted before #ui (stella-nova/pages/fractal-orb/main.js:143), no id. Module script, so the hook goes inside main.js (window.snSaver defined after animate() at ~:437). State object S (main.js:129) starts on 'Neutron' preset with speed 1.0 and orbRotation 1.0 rad/s (main.js:120-125), which is too brisk for calm viewing; animate() (main.js:415) does uTime+=dt*S.speed and orb.rotation.y+=dt*S.orbRotation, x at half rate. Hook enter(opts): hide '#ui' and '.grid-bg' and '#fps'; pick a calm preset from `presets` (main.js:77) such as 'Void' (speed .2, orbRotation .25) or 'Gray' (speed .3, rot .46), Object.assign(S, presets[name]); then scale S.speed and S.orbRotation by (1 - 0.7*calm); applyState() (main.js:227). Optional autopilot: every opts.seconds/2 lerp numeric fields of S toward the next preset over ~6 s (colors via THREE.Color.lerp on uniforms.uPrimaryColor/uSecondaryColor), calling applyState() each step; keep fractalIters integer and switch it at the midpoint only if equal-ish, or keep it fixed to avoid a pop. Set controls.enableDamping as-is; optionally camera.position.setLength(6) to reset zoom. Return { canvas: renderer.domElement, warmupMs: 500 }. Resize handler exists (main.js:399) so pinning full-frame works.
pages.calmRisks: Default Neutron preset spins at ~57 deg/s and internalAnim .8; chromatic aberration fringing. Preset buttons hard-cut all params (main.js:313-318), so a cycling autopilot must lerp.
pages.recordNotes: One WebGL canvas via EffectComposer; preserveDrawingBuffer is false but captureStream in rAF is fine. #state-display preset label is DOM and not captured (good).

pages.label: SDF Modeller
pages.render: webgpu (one canvas.gl per pane, up to 4 panes) + canvas2d overlay per pane (canvas.ov: gizmo, brackets, viewcube, grid labels)
pages.plan: Editor. Renders only dirty panes (frame() stella-nova/pages/sdf-lab/js/main.js:336), so idle is a frozen image; generic fallback would stretch a pane canvas whose buffer is sized from #viewport rects (layoutPanes main.js:283) and never move. Global window.__sdf = app (main.js:72). Curated content exists: EXAMPLES in js/examples.js:142 (primitives, pawn, creature, chain, tower, flange) with build() returning a doc. Hook (in js/main.js after boot): enter(opts) -> hide GUI selectors; app.panes.layout='single'; app.panes.active=3 (persp slot, mode 'lit'; see panes.js:38-43); app.disp = {grid:false, axes:false, bounds:'none', cube:false, ghost:false, shadows:true}; app.sel=[]; app.tool='select' so gizmoFor returns null (main.js:~380). Load example: app.loadDoc(EXAMPLES[k].build(), 'Saver') (main.js:197) which also calls frameAll. Autopilot per frame: slot=app.panes.slots[3]; slot.cam.yaw += dt*(8-6*calm) deg; slot.cam.pitch = 22+6*sin(t*0.1); app.dirtyPane(3). Every opts.seconds/3 switch example. For real 'authored' motion beyond orbit: animate a node value with app.setValues([{id, path:'...', value}]) e.g. smooth-union k or twist on the tower group, slowly, without history pollution (pass an opt to skip hist, or call app.F.update + writeGPU path through app.touch). CRITICAL: app.touch schedules FL.scheduleAutosave(app) (main.js:101) and pagehide calls FL.flushAutosave (main.js:507); loadDoc also pushes history. Saver mode must save/restore the user's autosave (snapshot localStorage key used by js/files.js before enter, restore on exit/pagehide) or add an app.saverMode flag that files.js checks, else the screensaver overwrites the user's model. Also set app.lastInput far in the past so panes refine to full res. Return { canvas: paneDom[3].gl, warmupMs: 1500 } (shader compile is async in setStructure).
pages.calmRisks: Example swaps recompile a shader (async, a frame or two of the previous scene then a cut); autosave clobber of user work; WebGPU required (#nogpu otherwise).
pages.recordNotes: Picture is the WebGPU canvas.gl of the active pane; the .ov 2D overlay (gizmo, grid labels, viewcube) is a separate canvas and not captured, which is fine with disp flags off. Canvas buffer equals pane size times dpr, so the pane must actually fill the viewport (layout 'single', #bar hidden: barH() is 52 unless phone, check pane top offset).

pages.label: Sphere Tracing Lab
pages.render: webgpu (two canvases #view 3D and #slice) + canvas2d overlays #viewOv and #sliceOv (probe circles, plane handle)
pages.plan: On-demand renderer: frame() (stella-nova/pages/sphere-tracing/main.js:461) only draws when gpuDirty/ovDirty, so idle is static. Global window.__lab = { S, loadPreset, setMode, setRelax, layout, dirty, ... } (main.js:487). State S (main.js:45) has cam {yaw,pitch,dist}, ray {o,a}, offset, mode. Presets in scene.js:39: 'one sphere','sphere minus box','smooth blobs','repeated pillars','twisted bar'. Hook in main.js after boot: enter(opts) -> remove 'open' from #panel, hide GUI, hide #paneSlice (or keep both side by side for an informational look, but recording only gets one canvas), call layout() (main.js:241) so #panes fills the frame and sizeCanvases() resizes #view. Autopilot via own rAF: S.cam.yaw += dt*0.12*(1-0.6*calm); S.cam.pitch = 0.3+0.1*sin(t*0.07); sweep S.ray.a = 0.25*sin(t*0.2) and S.offset = 0.6*sin(t*0.05) so the probe circles and the plane move; call dirty(false) each frame (dirty is exposed). Every opts.seconds/5 call loadPreset(next) and setMode among calm modes [0 shaded, 4 AO, 5 soft shadow] (setMode main.js:287). Optional informational variant: keep both panes (no #paneSlice hide) and composite #view+#viewOv+#slice+#sliceOv into one offscreen 2D canvas for recording.
pages.calmRisks: Preset change is a hard cut of geometry; 'steps' and 'compare' modes are high-contrast heatmaps, avoid them. scheduleStats runs a CPU grid trace 160 ms after each dirty(true); use dirty(false) in the autopilot to skip it.
pages.recordNotes: The probe path and plane outline are on #viewOv (2D overlay), not on #view; recording #view alone loses the teaching overlay. Slice view is a second WebGPU canvas. Composite needed if overlays matter.

pages.label: Rendering Engine
pages.render: webgl2 progressive path tracer (#gl) with CPU fallback canvas2d (#cpu) and canvas2d wire/gizmo overlay (#wire)
pages.plan: Classic script; globals SCENE (stella-nova/pages/cornell/main.js:70), CAM {az,el,R,fov,tx,ty,tz} (main.js:81) and APP (main.js:432) returning {init,setMode,setBackend,setGizmo,resetView,preset,tab} (main.js:784). loop() (main.js:556) in render mode steps GPU 2 spp/frame until 4000 samples then stops drawing, so idle converges to a still. Any camera move needs resetRender(), which is private: add it to the APP return object (one-line change) or call APP.resetView-style helpers. Hook: enter(opts) -> APP.setMode('render'); hide GUI selectors and #wire (drawScene(false) draws the selection gizmo onto it); make #canvas-wrap fill the frame (ResizeObserver resize() main.js:546 then applyRes after 180 ms). Autopilot 'stations': list of {az,el,R} views plus APP.preset('brand'|'classic'|other) (preset main.js:770); every opts.seconds/3 set CAM fields, call resetRender, and let it converge. To avoid a hard noisy cut, fade #canvas-wrap opacity to 0 over 1 s, switch, wait ~0.5 s of accumulation, fade back in. Optional slow drift: CAM.az += 0.5 deg every ~2 s with reset is too noisy; do not orbit continuously. Return { canvas: #gl, warmupMs: 1500 }. Also the logo text object '[ davesgames.io ]' is part of the scene (main.js:778).
pages.calmRisks: Each reset shows grainy low-sample noise for ~1 s (sparkle). Orbiting continuously means permanent noise. GPU-blank fallback switches to CPU canvas (#cpu) at low res.
pages.recordNotes: After convergence (samples >= 4000) the loop stops drawing #gl, so captureStream emits no new frames; MediaRecorder output may have long frame gaps but plays as a still. Opacity fades on DOM are NOT captured; the recording will hard-cut at station changes. Generic fallback ambiguity: #gl and #wire may be equal size, and the largest-canvas pick could take the transparent #wire overlay, so the explicit hook is needed. preserveDrawingBuffer false.

pages.label: Refraction
pages.render: webgl2 fullscreen-quad ray tracer
pages.plan: Generic is enough: one canvas #gl (stella-nova/pages/glass-cube/index.html:38); frame() (main.js:178) resizes its buffer to clientWidth*dpr every frame, so pinning it full-frame just works. Camera auto-orbits in the shader with iTime*u_spin, spin default .12 (main.js:63, shader line 96: camX=-.25*(iTime*u_spin)) which is a slow ~0.03 rad/s drift. HUD hidden in-frame via body.in-frame. Optional tier-2 upgrade for more life: animShape/animColor flags (main.js:86) are closure lets inside the async IIFE, so a hook inside main.js could set animShape=animColor=true (20 s curvature breathing, slow palette drift) and expose window.snSaver; not required.
pages.calmRisks: none
pages.recordNotes: Single canvas, all content in it. preserveDrawingBuffer false, fine for captureStream.

pages.label: Platonic Mirrors
pages.render: webgl2 fullscreen-quad raymarcher
pages.plan: Generic is enough: one canvas #c (stella-nova/pages/platonic-mirrors/index.html:36), resize() uses window.innerWidth/innerHeight (main.js:209) with a window resize listener, so pinning works. Idle auto-orbit drift S.orbit_speed .15 rotates rot_x/rot_y at out-of-phase rates (main.js:574-579), calm. pages.calmRisks: none (mirror/refraction highlights can be bright but steady)

pages.label: Branched Flow
pages.render: webgl2 (SDF raymarch + instanced filament ribbons, 4 passes, CPU-traced filaments)
pages.plan: Generic is enough: one canvas #gl; resize() sizes it from innerWidth/innerHeight*resScale (stella-nova/pages/cube_branched_flow/main.js:372) with a window resize listener, which the generic dispatch triggers. render() (main.js:466) advances simTime by dt*cur.timeScale (1.0) and computeGRot spins at moRB .5*rS .5 = .25 rad/s and moRC .115 rad/s (main.js:275), calm. Camera fixed (camT .5, camP .25, camD 55). Optional tier-2 polish inside the IIFE: cur.timeScale=0.6, slow camT += dt*0.03.
pages.calmRisks: CPU filament trace every frame (sN 78 seeds) is heavy on weak machines; additive glow is bright but steady.
pages.recordNotes: Single canvas, all passes end on screen. #info fps DOM excluded.

pages.label: Presence Orbs
pages.render: webgpu, one canvas per tile (66 tiles) + inspector canvas #m-orb + three canvas2d signal graphs (560x192)
pages.plan: Grid of 66 small WebGPU canvases; generic fallback would pick the largest canvas, which is a 560x192 2D signal graph (signals.js initSignals), so it fails. No window globals. Plan: add a single full-frame saver canvas and draw one species at a time into it, reusing the inspector path. In main.js (stella-nova/pages/presence-orbs/main.js) import makeSurface from gpu.js (exported, gpu.js:~33). enter(opts): create <canvas id='saver-orb'> fixed, square-centered (min(vw,vh)), sSurf=makeSurface(canvas); hide guiSelectors. In frame() (main.js:90) add: if (saver) drawTo(enc, saverTile, sSurf, sSurf.canvas.getBoundingClientRect(), dpr, now) next to the inspected draw at main.js:116, and skip the grid draws. Autopilot: saverTile = tiles[i] cycling through calm species every opts.seconds/4 (prefer glass/light/orb families; styles.json names like aura, nebula, fathom, duet); crossfade via a second surface or by fading canvas opacity (not captured). Drive state: cycle G.state among 'idle','listening','success' via the controls.js setState logic (not exported; replicate: t.prev=t.cur; t.cur=st; t.changedAt=clock()) — avoid 'error' (stutter entry) and 'responding'. Set G.tempo = 1 - 0.5*calm (state.js G). Signal generators in signals.js GENS already produce level (sine 9 s) and activity (noise 7 s) and tickSignals runs every frame, so the orb breathes on its own; consider lowering GENS amp for calm. Optional informational variant: show species name + description caption from t.s.name / t.s.species (styles.json) as DOM caption.
pages.calmRisks: 'error' state stutter and 'responding' high speed; 'thinking' has a 'wake' speed burst on entry (state.js ENTRY). Signal generator 'square'/'pulse' functions would flash if user changed them; defaults are sine/noise.
pages.recordNotes: Grid cannot be recorded as one canvas; the saver canvas approach makes it one WebGPU canvas. Alpha mode is premultiplied with clear alpha 0, so the recorded video background depends on the canvas backdrop; set the saver canvas CSS background to the ink color or render on opaque clear.

pages.label: Voxel Flythrough
pages.render: webgl2 (DDA voxel raymarch to FBO, CRT post pass, GPU boid swarm) + canvas2d overlay #pathOverlay (flight rails + radar HUD)
pages.plan: Already an autopilot: fly mode cruises a planned loop (loop() stella-nova/pages/voxel-flythrough/main.js:652). Generic fallback fails on sizing: resize() (main.js:386) reads #stage clientWidth and writes canvas.style.width/height in px, and #rail keeps its layout width under visibility:hidden, so the pinned canvas gets overwritten styles. Classic script, top-level const S (main.js:74) and window functions setU/setF/setMorph/togScan/togPath/setMode/togglePlay/setB (main.js:692-887). Hook in main.js: enter(opts) -> document.getElementById('rail').style.display='none'; #status-bar display none; #pathOverlay display none; then resize() so #stage fills; S.showPath=false (or togPath on #tog-path); setMode('fly'); S.playing=true; S.pathSpeed = 0.4 - 0.2*calm; S.morphSpeed = 0.08*(1-0.6*calm) (longer holds between terrain snaps, steppedMorph main.js:174); optionally turn scanlines off via togScan(document.getElementById('tog-scan')) for a cleaner image; boid speed via setB-style S/B object (sl-bspeed) leave default. Return { canvas: #gl, warmupMs: 1000 }.
pages.calmRisks: Terrain morph snaps over ~1.8 s each cycle (steppedMorph); re-plan hand-over drift; CRT scanlines can shimmer/moire on video; 78k boids heavy GPU; radar HUD sweep on overlay (hidden).
pages.recordNotes: Flight path rails and the radar HUD are on #pathOverlay (2D) and not captured, which is desired for a clean recording. #gl buffer is resScale .7 with a 2.6 MP budget, so the recording is upscaled.

pages.label: Image to Three.js
pages.render: webgl (three.js, on-demand rendering, shadows, RoomEnvironment PMREM)
pages.plan: On-demand: loop() (stella-nova/pages/img2threejs/main.js:281) renders only when S.dirty or controls.update() returns true, so idle is static. Global window.__img2 = { S, MODELS, renderer, scene, camera, controls, holder, setModel, setPass, setExplode, frame, dirty } (main.js:295). Generic fallback would stretch: renderer.setSize(w,h,false) is driven by a ResizeObserver on #view (main.js:81-89), which stays inside .stage (grid with 380px side column, style.css:34). Hook (module, inside main.js after __img2): enter(opts) -> hide guiSelectors; make .stage position:fixed; inset:0; z-index top (ResizeObserver then resizes the renderer); controls.autoRotate=true; controls.autoRotateSpeed = 0.8*(1-0.6*calm) (OrbitControls update returns true, so it renders every frame). Autopilot timed reveal per model: await setModel(m) (main.js:242), then step setPass(0..7) (main.js:248, keepView) every ~opts.seconds/10 to show the 8 build passes (blockout to optimisation), then a gentle setExplode(true) for a few seconds and setExplode(false) (eases at dt*5, main.js:283), then next model of MODELS (chair, kettle, lantern). frame() (main.js:179) refits the review camera on model change. Optional caption from MODELS[m].passes[p] name via PASS_NAMES. Return { canvas: renderer.domElement, warmupMs: 1500 }.
pages.calmRisks: Pass changes swap the whole group (load disposes and rebuilds), a visible cut; first passes are clay-coloured. Factory import and textures are local files, no network beyond same origin.
pages.recordNotes: Single WebGL canvas; the pass card, scores and reference image are DOM and not captured. Render on demand means captureStream gets frames only while autoRotate is on.
